research.facts:
NBA Hammers Clippers — 5 Picks, $30M Fine, Ballmer Suspended
**Decision:** NEW STORY (investigation ruling just announced September 2, 2026)
**Sources:**
1. NBA.com official press release: "NBA announces penalties and findings arising from investigation of LA Clippers and Kawhi Leonard" — nba.com/news/nba-investigation-findings-la-clippers
2. CNN: "Clippers docked 5 first-round draft picks and fined $30 million following Kawhi Leonard probe" — cnn.com/2026/09/02/sport/clippers-kawhi-leonard-nba-investigation
3. Yardbarker: "Clippers Kawhi Leonard Salary Cap Ruling 2026" — yardbarker.com
**Key Facts (Verified):**
- Investigation conducted by law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz (HIGH — official NBA.com source)
- Clippers are a "prior offender" of salary cap circumvention rules (HIGH — official NBA.com)
- Corporate partners involved: Aspiration Partners, Boingo Wireless, Daktronics, Lockton Insurance (HIGH — official NBA.com)
- Penalty: 5 consecutive first-round picks forfeited starting 2029 (HIGH — multiple sources)
- Fine: $30 million (HIGH — multiple sources)
- Steve Ballmer suspended (HIGH — multiple sources)
- Lawrence Frank and Gillian Zucker also suspended (HIGH — multiple sources)
- Kawhi Leonard must pay $700,000 restitution (HIGH — multiple sources)
- Leonard NOT suspended (HIGH — multiple sources)
- Dennis Robertson (uncle/former business rep) banned from NBA business dealings (HIGH — multiple sources)
- Leonard fired Robertson in June (HIGH — KROX Sports reporting)
**Freshness:** Ruling announced September 2, 2026 — 1 day old. Fresh.
**Why it matters:** Biggest NBA team penalty in years. Clippers mortgaged their future. Kawhi's trade to Toronto can now proceed. Massive off-court story days before training camp.
